cohort: Pregnant women undergoing routine anesthesia induction (n = 66)
finding: Preoxygenation with the 30 s 4 deep vital capacity method resulted in greater FiO(2) and FeO(2) values and did not cause a significant decrease in post-intubation ORI values compared to the 3 min tidal volume method.
